text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we're still seeing intermittent TLS handshake retries on cross-region routes after autoscale. Need owners and concrete timelines for remediation.

jin: I'll own immediate mitigation: enforce fail-fast after 3 handshake attempts + prefer same-region backend on first try. Will do a 3% canary. ETA: 24h.

alexa: I'll own telemetry and alert tuning. Adding cipher-suite breakdown and a retries-by-path dashboard tile. ETA: 48h.

marta: sample log pulled this morning: `2026-03-28T03:12:09Z lb-router us-east-1->eu-west-1 TLS handshake timeout retries=8 backend=lb-a`

jin: created task SRE-2620 for the canary + rollback criteria. Canary command: `deploy --svc lb-router --canary 3% --image sha:1a2b` and synthetic probe `curl --max-time 2 /health`.

ops-bot: Created task <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2620|SRE-2620> assigned to jin, due 2026-03-29 18:00 UTC.

alexa: telemetry query I'll use: `SELECT dst_region, cipher, count(*) FROM lb_handshakes WHERE retries>1 GROUP BY 1,2`  will post dashboard and alert `lb.cross_region.retries` with threshold = 4x baseline over 10m.

jin: canary started, monitoring now. Will report back in 30m.

marta: longer-term items: 1) CI handshake matrix during scale-ups (ops) 2) routing sticky fix to avoid route re-eval during hot scale (platform) 3) harmonize TLS profiles across regions (security). Adding to the postmortem epic.

alexa: telemetry patch deployed to staging, dashboard tile added, attaching runbook to alert.

jin: early canary numbers: retries on canary 0.5% vs baseline 1.7%. Posting artifacts to SRE-2620.

marta: thanks — recap owners/ETAs: jin (SRE-2620) mitigation 24h, alexa telemetry 48h, ops/platform/security long-term items 1w. Recheck in 24h here.
